svg.text: The 10 holes, concept v1: Bright Carnival
Played 10 → 1. Concept sketches to scale (1 grid square = 1 m), not construction drawings. Same geometry as docs/03-hole-spec-sheet.md.

g.text: Warm-Up
Par 2 · Simple · Straight lane with a gentle hump. Teaches the turf speed.
Bank Shot
Par 2 · Simple · L-shape: bounce off the 45° wall to turn the corner.
The Windmill
Par 3 · Hero · Putt through the tunnel under the turning sails.
Pinball
Par 3 · Mid · Pin field + bumpers + graffiti backboard (Punk Ball nod).
Split Decision
Par 3 · Mid · Three tunnels in a wall: one short route, two long.
The Ramp
Par 3 · Mid · Climb to a raised green; clear guards keep balls in.
The Barn
Par 3 · Hero · Dogleg through the barn tunnel to the back green.
Island Green
Par 3 · Mid · Narrow bridge over a glowing moat to a round green.
The Clock
Par 3 · Hero · Clock-face green; the hands at 11:59 are bumpers.
Midnight
Par 2 · Hero · Under the 2027 arch; the last cup keeps your ball.
